title: Aging Kiln Co-op Dilemma
setting: The small, sun-faded pottery co-op sits on a quiet country lane, its two wood-fired kilns older than every current member, all of whom joined within the last two years. The collective is weeks away from shutting down unless they can complete a successful bulk glaze order for a local café, but no one knows the original firing specs of the aging kilns to avoid ruining their final batches.

characters.name: Jessa
characters.tendencies: She obsessively tracks firing cycle times, kiln temperature logs, and inventory counts, often correcting vague group estimates with precise numerical data.

characters.name: Marisol
characters.tendencies: She acts as the co-op’s public face, pitching their pottery to local businesses, mediating group disagreements, and keeping the community-focused spirit of the collective alive.

characters.name: Tao
characters.tendencies: They’re the only current member with hands-on kiln experience, having learned basic firing techniques from their grandparent who worked at the co-op’s original run decades ago.
